name: adr183-go-check-3
results: Stopped deliberately after launch: a targeted -race repetition showed the first test fix incomplete. Diagnosis: the forwarder returns at the original deadline when its own timer fires a moment before the caller context records expiry, so the ctx.Err() == nil check was stricter than the contract (one GET, at most one POST, interval neither shortened nor widened). The check now tests early return against the recorded caller end directly; 30 -race repetitions passed before adr183-go-check-4.
